title: Surreal Portrait Fusion
description: A close-up portrait of a woman's face is overlaid with vibrant psychedelic colors and patterns. Her hair and cheek merge into a fantastical scene featuring a girl with flowing orange hair riding a colorful horse, a frog-like humanoid character in a green jacket, large pink flowers with yellow centers, rolling green hills, and a small horse on a hill under a moody sky.
prompt: A vibrant surreal portrait of a young woman's face with one side in natural skin tones and the other covered in geometric patches of magenta, yellow, and green. Her hair transforms into a fantastical landscape where a girl with long flowing orange hair rides a colorful patterned horse. A frog-like humanoid character in a green jacket stands among oversized pink flowers with yellow centers. Rolling green hills and a smaller horse appear in the background under a dark cloudy sky, psychedelic color blending, detailed painting style.
